name: Love Love Fromage!
source:
In the heart of Saint-Pierre, a village nestled in the French countryside, Leonie's life is about to take a dramatic turn. Once a quaint village famous for its rich cheese-making heritage, Saint-Pierre's delicate balance between the Dumont merchant family, the Fournier shepherds, and the Chevalier cheesemakers is upended by the epidemic, like a perfectly crafted wheel of cheese gone awry. As the village's intricate web of relationships and traditions begins to unravel, Leonie must navigate her new reality and find her own path. Along the way, she'll encounter Dr. Alexandre and Edmond, who will play important roles in her journey of self-discovery. Will she find love along the way, or will her focus on self-discovery be the greatest reward? After all: “When the cheese is ripe, the heart is ready…”

[From [url=https://veryberrybunny.itch.io/love-love-fromage]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在坐落于法国乡间腹地的圣皮埃尔村，莱奥妮的生活即将迎来一场剧变。这座古朴宁静的村落曾以悠久的奶酪酿造传统闻名遐迩，然而一场突如其来的疫情彻底打破了迪蒙商贾家族、富尼耶牧羊人家族与谢瓦利耶奶酪匠家族之间的微妙平衡——恰似一轮精工细作的奶酪骤然变质走味。随着村里盘根错节的人际关系与古老传统开始分崩离析，莱奥妮必须在全新的现实中摸索前行，走出属于自己的道路。旅途中，她将邂逅亚历山大医生与埃德蒙，两人将在她的自我探索之旅中扮演举足轻重的角色。她究竟会在途中收获真爱，还是会将发现真我视作最珍贵的馈赠？毕竟俗话说得好：“奶酪熟透之时，便是芳心就绪之日……”

[摘自[url=https://veryberrybunny.itch.io/love-love-fromage]itch.io[/url]]
